import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687689/attempts/a19917c2b2c442ba9dde2ee9fd880e7d/system/state/workspace/programs/task-74c3316b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Transpose the source, then reflect-repeat its row and column indices.
    base = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)]
    pattern = list(range(len(base))) + list(range(len(base) - 1, -1, -1))
    # For a 3-cell side, the demonstrated period is 0,1,2,2,1,0,0,1,2.
    # Repeat the reflected source indices to make a three-times larger grid.
    indices = (pattern + pattern)[:3 * len(base)]
    return [[base[indices[r]][indices[c]] for c in indices] for r in indices]
'''
p.write_text(source)
